title: The coordinator: one lead agent walks a draft to a built project, gate by gate
request: A lead agent over an explicit state machine (problem card, data cards, links, analysis, workflow, pipeline) delegating to roles through typed hand-offs and moving state only through deterministic gates; it never builds while a blocker is open and says which. The owner's morning replayed must end in the fraud project, and a planted bad hand-off must be refused.
spec: A pure state machine and hand-off gate in dclab_core; a host that gathers a draft's facts, acts on the next state, runs in the agent harness, and builds through the same checks as the build route.
plan: Map what exists: the card, the meet check, the label join across drafts, the build's checks.
Factor the build's checks and the table-bringing into functions the route and the coordinator share.
Write the machine: states in order, blockers with evidence, the hand-off gate.
Write the host and replay the morning; plant a bad hand-off.

decisions.decision: Questions a file can settle wait for the data and links states.
decisions.why: The morning's labels question is answered by the file of known cases; asking it first would ask what the data already says.

decisions.decision: A hand-off naming a missing column is refused whole, and the role's rules stand.
decisions.why: A role that names a column the tables do not hold has invented it; keeping the rest of its answer would trust the same reading.

decisions.decision: The build's checks are one function both the route and the coordinator read.
decisions.why: Two copies of the checks would drift, and the coordinator would build what the route refuses.

decisions.decision: No build while a question to the person is open.
decisions.why: A build with a question open is one of the session record's own failure signals.

change: dclab_core/coordinator.py (new; dclab-core 0.21.0, contract coordinator_situation.v1), dclab_rnd/draft/coordinator.py (new), draft/api.py (build_blockers, bring_table), agents/harness.py (the coordinator agent); tests/test_coordinator.py (new), test_agent_harness.py; CHANGELOG, the plan, the roadmap, CLAUDE.md.

findings.defect: The walk asked a question the cases would settle.
findings.scenario: From the cases' draft the coordinator stopped on which column holds the outcome, before bringing the table.
findings.cause: Only the data and labels questions waited for the links.
findings.fix: While the draft holds only cases, or its cases are elsewhere, the outcome question waits for the links too.

findings.defect: The walk stopped although it was making progress.
findings.scenario: Answering the entity question while the card still waited for the moment counted as no progress.
findings.cause: Progress was the situation changing, not the action's outcome.
findings.fix: No progress is the same outcome twice, or three times in a loop.

findings.defect: It built with a question open.
findings.scenario: The morning's project was built while the entity question waited, so the bikers were not the groups.
findings.cause: Only blocking card questions held the build.
findings.fix: No build while a question to the person is open.

findings.defect: A table that could not be read was built around.
findings.scenario: The brought table's analysis failed after the cases moved aside; the cases alone became a project labelled by itself.
findings.cause: The pipeline's failed status was ignored, failed files did not block, and the build did not see the label file active alone.
findings.fix: The walk stops on a failed bring and on any failed file; the build refuses while the label file is the active table.

findings.defect: The workflow state only checked that steps existed.
findings.cause: The drawn workflow was never validated.
findings.fix: The workflow is checked as a model's proposal is; the plan's status says what else stays open.

findings.defect: From the table's draft the walk never saw the cases in another draft.
findings.scenario: Started on the orders draft, it stopped on the outcome question.
findings.cause: Offers exist only on the cases' side.
findings.fix: The table's draft names the draft holding its cases and stops there.

findings.defect: A malformed answer was recorded as an accepted hand-off.
findings.scenario: An answer whose after was a mapping named no column and passed the gate.
findings.cause: Items not in the hand-off's shape were skipped silently.
findings.fix: An answer not in the shape is refused as malformed.

findings.defect: The host's own column counted as a data card.
findings.scenario: A draft without a data card allowed an empty hand-off.
findings.cause: The check ran after adding the host's is_case.
findings.fix: Without the tables' own columns nothing is taken on trust.

findings.defect: The question that stopped the walk was missing from the person's record.
findings.scenario: An unanswered question was not in the asked list.
findings.cause: The answer was asked for directly.
findings.fix: Through the person's ask, which records every question.

findings.defect: The walk did not hold the draft's turn, and a loop of two questions went on.
findings.scenario: A Home turn could interleave with the walk; A/B/A/B asked the person up to twenty times.
findings.cause: No turn lock; only consecutive repeats were seen.
findings.fix: The walk holds the draft's turn; an outcome seen three times stops it.

findings.defect: The model's words were kept in the draft.
findings.scenario: The data investigator's reasons were stored with the hand-off.
findings.cause: The role's parsed output was stored whole.
findings.fix: Only the columns it proposed are kept.

measurements.name: the owner's morning replayed
measurements.gate: ends in the fraud project with labels joined on order_id, partial, biker_id the groups, and the planted hand-off refused
measurements.result: built; labels key order_id, partial, group biker_id, family rare_event; driver_rating refused
limits: Invented replica; started from the cases' draft; scripted person.

outcome: One lead agent walks a draft from the problem to a built project through explicit gates, never building around a blocker, and refuses a role's hand-off that names a column the tables do not hold.
lessons: When two paths decide the same thing (the build route and the coordinator), make them read one function.
Progress is an action's outcome, not a change of state: answering an open question changes nothing the state machine sees.
A failure that happens after a file moved aside leaves a state that looks complete: test the failure in the middle.
risks: Only the data investigator's hand-off is gated.
The coordinator is not yet reachable from a route or the page.
